freezones.name: DMCC
freezones.description: DMCC is ranked the world's number one free zone for nine consecutive years. Located in Jumeirah Lakes Towers, it hosts 22,000+ businesses across 170+ nationalities. Ideal for commodities trading, financial services, and professional consultancies.

freezones.name: Dubai Internet City (DIC)
freezones.description: Dubai's premier technology hub hosting Google, Microsoft, IBM, and Facebook. Ideal for tech companies, IT firms, and digital startups seeking a prestigious address in the Middle East.

freezones.name: Dubai Media City (DMC)
freezones.description: The Arab world's leading free zone for media and creative industries. Home to CNN, Reuters, BBC, and hundreds of regional agencies. Perfect for media companies, content creators, and production houses.

freezones.name: DIFC
freezones.description: One of the world's top 10 financial centres. DIFC operates under its own civil and commercial law system based on English common law. Home to 5,700+ active registered companies including 17 of the world's top 20 banks.

freezones.name: JAFZA
freezones.description: One of the world's largest free zones, adjacent to Jebel Ali Port (the busiest port in the Middle East). JAFZA is ideal for logistics, manufacturing, and large-scale trading businesses requiring warehousing and industrial space.

freezones.name: Dubai South (DWC)
freezones.description: A 145 sq km economic zone built around Al Maktoum International Airport. Perfect for aviation-linked businesses, logistics, and e-commerce companies needing proximity to one of the world's largest airports.

freezones.name: Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO)
freezones.description: An integrated technology park combining residential, commercial, and industrial facilities. DSO is UAE's dedicated technology free zone, offering subsidized utilities and land for tech manufacturing and R&D.

freezones.name: DAFZA
freezones.description: Strategically located adjacent to Dubai International Airport (DXB). DAFZA offers world-class facilities for companies requiring rapid air freight access. Home to 1,700+ companies from 120+ countries.

freezones.name: Dubai Healthcare City (DHCC)
freezones.description: The world's largest free zone dedicated to healthcare. DHCC hosts hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centers, medical schools, and wellness facilities. Regulated by the Health Regulation Authority (HRA).

freezones.name: Dubai Knowledge Park (DKP)
freezones.description: The only free zone in the region dedicated to human resource management and training. DKP is home to universities, training institutes, and e-learning companies.

freezones.name: Gold & Diamond Park
freezones.description: The UAE's hub for jewellery manufacturing and trading. Home to 90+ manufacturers and 350+ retailers. Offers specialized facilities for gem cutting, polishing, and jewellery design.

freezones.name: Dubai Design District (d3)
freezones.description: Dubai's creative capital for fashion, luxury, and design. d3 hosts major design studios, fashion brands, art galleries, and architects in a stunning waterfront campus near Downtown Dubai.

freezones.name: Sharjah Free Zone (SHAMS)
freezones.description: One of the most affordable UAE free zones. SHAMS is popular with freelancers, consultants, e-commerce businesses, and small companies looking for cost-effective setup with fast licensing.

freezones.name: Meydan Free Zone
freezones.description: Located at the iconic Meydan racecourse in Mohammed Bin Rashid City. Meydan Free Zone offers affordable annual trade licences and is popular for consultancies, trading companies, and e-commerce operations.

freezones.name: RAKEZ
freezones.description: One of the UAE's most cost-competitive free zones. RAKEZ offers industrial land, warehousing, and manufacturing facilities in Ras Al Khaimah with significantly lower setup and operational costs compared to Dubai.

freezones.name: AFZA
freezones.description: One of the UAE's oldest and most affordable free zones. AFZA offers fast company registration, low-cost warehousing, and easy access to Ajman and Sharjah industrial areas.

freezones.name: UAQFTZ
freezones.full_name: Umm Al Quwain Free Trade Zone
freezones.description: A small but strategic free zone offering very low-cost industrial and storage facilities. UAQFTZ is ideal for light manufacturing, warehousing, and businesses needing affordable UAE market access.

freezones.name: FSEZ
freezones.description: A creative industry free zone on the UAE's east coast. Popular with media professionals, artists, consultants, and sports businesses looking for an affordable UAE presence.

freezones.name: ADGM
freezones.description: Abu Dhabi's international financial centre located on Al Maryah Island. Regulated under English common law, ADGM is home to global banks, asset managers, and FinTech startups. Direct competitor to DIFC in the financial services space.

freezones.name: Twofour54
freezones.description: Abu Dhabi's media and entertainment free zone. Home to major broadcasters, production companies, and game developers. Offers access to professional studios, recording facilities, and editing suites.

freezones.name: Abu Dhabi Airport Free Zone (ADAFZ)
freezones.description: Strategically positioned at Abu Dhabi International Airport. ADAFZ provides logistics, cargo handling, and industrial facilities with direct airfreight access across the Middle East, Africa, and Asia.

freezones.name: Kizad
freezones.description: The UAE's largest integrated industrial and logistics zone. Encompassing 417 sq km adjacent to Khalifa Port, KIZAD hosts major manufacturers across metals, chemicals, and food industries.

freezones.name: IFZA
freezones.description: One of Dubai's fastest-growing free zones offering competitive pricing and fast registration. IFZA is popular with startups, freelancers, and SMEs requiring a Dubai address with flexible activity options.

freezones.name: Dubai Studio City
freezones.description: The UAE's hub for film and television production. Dubai Studio City offers purpose-built studios, production facilities, and post-production services. Home to MBC Group and major production houses.

freezones.name: International Humanitarian City (IHC)
freezones.description: The world's largest humanitarian logistics hub, hosting 72 organizations including UN agencies, NGOs, and international humanitarian organizations. Dedicated to disaster relief and aid operations.

ded.name: DED
ded.full_name: Department of Economy and Tourism (formerly DED)
ded.description: The DED issues mainland trade licences in Dubai, allowing businesses to operate anywhere in the UAE and trade directly with the local market without restrictions. Unlike free zones, DED-licensed companies can bid on government contracts and open branches across all emirates.
ded.ownership_rules: 100% foreign ownership now permitted for most activities (post-2021 Commercial Companies Law amendment)
ded.local_agent: No longer required for most activities

ded_abudhabi.name: ADDED
ded_abudhabi.full_name: Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development
ded_abudhabi.description: Issues mainland trade licences in Abu Dhabi, granting full access to the Abu Dhabi market and government contracts.

sharjah_mainland.name: SAEED
sharjah_mainland.description: Mainland licensing authority for the emirate of Sharjah. Popular alternative for lower-cost mainland operations with proximity to Dubai.
